blacklistabilityReview.evidence: EVM GLDon exposes issuer-selected compliance and tokenPauseManager contracts; current role getters retain these controllers on Ethereum, BNB and HyperEVM. Finalized Solana mint metadata exposes freeze authority 51QVCuHfL1FeNjd8BDeffCKhCcAYoULnVB3yjNhShiuK and a pausable extension. These establish direct holder-control exposure independently of issuer minting.

oracleRisk.summary: GLDon Final Terms appoint the issuer and Ondo Finance as calculation agents, reference broker-provided GLD prices and multiply those prices by the attributable shares per token for issuance/redemption. Issuer-published SyntheticSharesOracle addresses are Ethereum 0x9bc39db6fbb44b91a48b8d5a6c208b82b1741be6 and BNB 0xf4fd8a1b412633e10527454137a29db7aa35f15e; these publish stock-to-token multipliers, not an independent GLD/USD price or reserve reconciliation. Off-hours valuation remains issuer-discretionary.

branchApplicability.rationale: This open-ended secured tracker uses contractual fund-security issuance/redemption valuation rather than borrower collateral/liquidation markets. Its underlying GLD ETF price and stock-to-token multiplier remain applicable; fixed physical-gold redemption is not a GLDon right.
